newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq ends year on positive swing.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq ends year on positive swing.

text.p: The Nasdaq Composite Index ended the year on a upswing as investors waited to the last minute to square their portolios.
"It was a very, very busy end of the year. People were shoring up positions or making last minute transactions for tax purposes," one trader said.
Another trader said: "There were no clear trends, basically just a day for housekeeping."
The Nasdaq Composite Index gained 3.28, or 0.25 percent, to 1291.03. The Dow lost 101, or 1.54 percent, to close unofficially at 6448.
The long bond lost 1-9/32 to yield 6.64 percent after some negatively perceived economic data spooked investors.
Technology stocks were mixed after Monday's sell off. Intel Corp dropped 2-5/16 to 130-15/16, Apple Computer Inc fell 7/8 to 20-7/8 and Microsoft Corp shed 7/8 to 82-5/8.
But Dell Computer Corp and Compaq Computer Corp showed moderate inceases after NatWest Securities raised their earnings estimates.
Gaining stocks beat losing stocks 2733 to 1834 on total volume of 670 million.
